decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development, due to its excessive density, design and layout, would constitute a cramped overdevelopment of the site, and would fail to meet the Council's residential density and housing standards, resulting in inadequate private amenity space and substandard living conditions, detrimental to the residential amenity of the future occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1, H.4.1 and H 4.2. of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003)

Condition : 2 - The proposed development, due to its size, position and top-heavy appearance, would result in an unduly dominant and obtrusive development, which would be out of scale and character with the streetscene, and detrimental to the visual and residential amenities of the area, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.1.1. of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003)

Condition : 3 - The proposed off-street parking provision, due to the insufficient number of spaces, and substandard design, layout and access, would fail to meet the Council's Parking Standards, and would result in the loss of a CPZ parking bay, resulting in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal is contrary to policies T.1.4 and T.5.3 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003)
description: Erection of 2 x three-bedroom semi-detached houses and 2 x four-bedroom semi-detached houses with associated parking
